summary: @servicetitan/intl preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which is itself obfuscated with hex-renamed identifiers and property-indirection wrappers. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line JavaScript blob obfuscated with string-array rotation (rotator function shifting a large numeric/string array, decoder with a scrambled alphabet) and contains no code relevant to the package's advertised internationalization purpose. The package name and scope resemble an internal ServiceTitan namespace, but the shipped code fetches a second language runtime at install and uses it to execute an opaque payload — installing the package runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
